about_the_game:
Get ready for a taster version of Heist Haven! Check out the Industrial District, try out 2 full Heists and level up your character and crew to Rank 2!

1 to 4 players online

The demo is playable in single-player and with up to 4 players online. Just invite your friends by opening the Steam Overlay, or let them join you. Want to join someone else? Check out the Session Browser in the main menu. Sessions which have been set to "Open" can be joined here. You can set your "Session Privacy" in the Settings screen under "Gameplay".

Progression to the full game

All progress you make in the game now will carry over to the full game. You can level your crew and character up to level 2. In the full game, you will be able to progress further. Any cash you stash, weapons you acquire and vehicles you steal will be waiting for you in the full game.

content_descriptors.notes: Heist Haven features frequent violence and acts that are criminal in nature.
